scripts.text:
[Hunting Missions]
If you so choose, I can assign
you a random hunting quest.
Some are easier than others, but
the rewards increase with difficulty.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵任務]
如果你願意，我可以隨機分配一項狩獵任務。
任務有難有易，難度越高，獎勵越豐厚。

scripts.text:
[Hunting Missions]
Missions points are shared
amongst all your characters.
You can't take missions on
multiple characters at once.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵任務]
任務點數由你所有角色共享。
你不能同時用多個角色接取任務。
